dashboard.title: Family overview
dashboard.subtitle: This number is the sum of the ledger, for checking against the bank
dashboard.currentBalanceDesc: Sum of entries that are not voided
dashboard.totalContributionDesc: Positive amounts only. Spending does not reduce this
dashboard.repairTitle: The cached balance does not match the ledger

mortgage.termsLine: {{rate}}% a year · {{installment}} a month · {{years}} years · interest from {{start}} · debit day {{payDay}} · cash interest day {{creditDay}}
mortgage.overdue: That debit date has passed, and no matching principal entry is in the ledger.
mortgage.cleared: The ledger shows the principal is paid off.
mortgage.overpaid: Principal repaid is higher than the original loan. The principal note may be matching other expenses.
mortgage.formulaGap: The bank debits {{bank}} each month. The standard formula gives {{formula}}. Next principal is your installment minus that period's interest.
mortgage.cashCaption: Same annual rate as the mortgage, actual days ÷ 365. Days that have not happened yet keep today's balance.
mortgage.noteHint: An expense that is not voided and has the same note counts as principal repaid. An entry dated a day or two after the debit day still belongs to that month.
mortgage.formulaHint: On the original loan and full term, the formula installment is {{formula}}. On the balance still owed and {{months}} periods left, it is about {{reset}}. Changing the rate does not replace the installment you saved.
mortgage.assumption: The starting values were read off the existing ledger. Change them here if the bank's figures differ.

interest.title: Interest roughly saved
interest.caption: Positive end-of-day balance in the selected dates × the mortgage rate ÷ 365. Change the rate in the loan settings above.
interest.missing: Save an annual rate to estimate interest avoided in this range.

reconcile.title: Check the bank
reconcile.caption: Compared with the ledger total up to this date.
reconcile.bankHigher: The bank is {{amount}} higher. A deposit may be missing.
reconcile.bookHigher: The ledger is {{amount}} higher. An expense may be missing.

password.title: Change password
password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match

transaction.title: Add an entry
transaction.subtitle: A deposit, an expense, or money that went in and straight back out
transaction.passHint: Records a deposit and a matching expense on the same day. The balance stays put, and the contribution still counts.
transaction.operatorNotRequired: Ordinary expenses are not a personal contribution
transaction.voidPair: This is a pass-through. Voiding removes both the deposit and the expense.
transaction.editPair: Saving updates both sides of this pass-through.
